active.title: P1 Durable Stop terminal receipt
active.question: Does an actual Stop return only after the authoritative session.stopped event and stopped checkpoint/snapshot are durably persisted and visible through the receipt surface?
active.method: Reuse existing owners and tests. No runtime source patch is authorized. Run one bounded persistence acceptance against current code; only if that fails may a repair be planned.

owner_map.adapter: electron/agent-runtime-adapter.js AgentRuntimeAdapter.stop() preserves completed sessions and delegates running sessions to UnifiedAgentService.stop()
owner_map.service: src/agent/executive/UnifiedAgentService.js stop() aborts LiveAgentCore and delegates terminal-state ownership to AgentSessionRuntime.stop()
owner_map.session_router: src/agent/executive/AgentSessionRuntime.js stop() resolves the session and delegates to AgentExecutive.stop()
owner_map.terminal_authority: src/agent/executive/AgentExecutive.js stop() appends session.stop_requested, aborts the active attempt, waits for the run loop, then ensures session.stopped plus _checkpoint('stopped') before returning
owner_map.durable_store: src/agent/executive/AgentEventStore.js append() writes events.jsonl; checkpoint() atomically writes checkpoints/<id>.json and snapshot.json; writes are awaited/serialized
owner_map.receipt_projection: UnifiedAgentService.receipts() projects persisted executive events with eventId as receiptId and lists checkpoints

proves: running sessions delegate to service.stop exactly once
real AgentSessionRuntime -> AgentExecutive in-flight Stop aborts a blocking provider and returns status stopped
missing: assert receipt projection exposes terminal receipt

proves: session state is written to configured stateRoot
event/receipt infrastructure contains durable session events
AgentEventStore persists and reloads execution events

active.falsifier: If a bounded current-code acceptance cannot observe session.stopped in events.jsonl, a stopped checkpoint/snapshot, and a projected receipt after stop() returns, classify the product gap and only then authorize a runtime repair.

proven_findings.detail: AgentExecutive.stop is the terminal-state authority. AgentEventStore is the durable persistence owner. UnifiedAgentService.receipts projects stored event IDs as receipts and lists checkpoints.

Existing adapter/resilience/integration/trace tests collectively cover delegation, stopped state, state-root persistence, receipts infrastructure and event-store persistence, but no existing regression asserts the full durable Stop persistence contract.

next_acceptance.question: Does the current implementation already satisfy the full durable Stop persistence contract?
next_acceptance.observable: Create one temporary in-flight AgentSessionRuntime session, stop it through the current runtime owner, then verify returned status stopped, events.jsonl contains exactly one session.stopped terminal event, a stopped checkpoint and snapshot.json exist, and UnifiedAgentService.receipts projects the session.stopped event plus checkpoint.
next_acceptance.falsifier: Any missing terminal event, checkpoint, snapshot state or projected receipt after stop() returns proves the current implementation is not durably terminal and authorizes a focused repair.
